records.title: Consolidating the Decentralized Integrated Water Resource Management System in Sanaa Basin, Yemen
records.description: The project will work with local stakeholders, especially water user associations (WUAs), to enhance their capacity and knowledge on water resources investments and management, water conflict resolution, climate-smart agriculture, and water productivity monitoring.

field_extracted_original_innovat: Consolidating the Decentralized Integrated Water Resource Management System in Sanaa Basin, Yemen
_annotations.field_shorter_description: Some of the innovations that the project will implement are: (i) the development of WaPOR Level 3 data, which will provide high-resolution information on evapotranspiration, land use, and water productivity to the WUAs and other stakeholders; (ii) the development of a mobile application linked to WaPOR, which will enable easy access and use of the data for decision-making and planning; (iii) the promotion of rainwater harvesting and groundwater recharge techniques to enhance the availability and quality of water resources; and (iv) the formation of a Sana'a Basin Water Association Union, which will strengthen the coordination and cooperation among the WUAs and other water governance institutions

records.title: Enhancing livestock production efficiency through digitalization and precision farming
records.description: The project aims to leverage digital technology to create a comprehensive database that will inform livestock policy interventions across various value chains. It focuses on enhancing poultry and pig production by providing technical support for informed business decisions, improving efficiency, management, and tracking product movement. Additionally, it seeks to promote and improve dairy production through better farming practices and reduced labor. The project also aims to strengthen institutional capacities within the livestock sector to elevate quality and standards. Lastly, it endeavors to boost fish production to replace imports and penetrate niche export markets.

field_extracted_original_innovat: Enhancing livestock production efficiency through digitalization and precision farming
_annotations.field_shorter_description: Use of digital technologies such as mobile applications, online systems, blockchain, and geospatial technologies to create a comprehensive database that will inform livestock policy interventions throughout livestock value chains.

records.title: Accelerating SDG achievement through digital transformation to strengthen community resilience in Micronesia
records.description: The core objective of the program is to gradually transfer the ownership of services to government institutions. It is innovative in its integrated and holistic approach to digital transformation, which goes beyond technology adoption and addresses the policy, legislative, strategic, capacity, and service delivery aspects of digital transformation, and in its smart islands concept, which aims to create a model of sustainable and inclusive development for remote and vulnerable communities, leveraging digital solutions across multiple sectors and SDGs. The project will also explore the use of emerging technologies and data-driven decision-making to enhance the impact and efficiency of digital transformation.
